datasheet_identity.title: SMAF Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: Citation: hongjiacheng SS26F THRU SS220F, SMAF Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier, Rev:1.0, p. 1.

The supplied PDF SHA-256 matches the expected e5dd861e0958abea546a340908a7bc1a9075876d4571825c433b491e5bc615ea, but the file is truncated: it declares three pages and terminates during an embedded image on p. 1. Only the available p. 1 content streams were examined.
Available p. 1 conditions: Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.

Available p. 1 maximum-rating table identifies SS26F as the 60 V member of the SS22F through SS220F family: VRRM = 60 V, maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) = 2 A, and non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM = 50 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave. These ratings are operating-region metadata, not fitted points.
Available p. 1 storage temperature is -55 to 150 degC and junction temperature is -55 to 125 degC; typical thermal resistances are RthetaJA = 70 degC/W and RthetaJL = 20 degC/W.
The datasheet states that the cathode line denotes the cathode end. Schottky polarity is therefore preserved as anode to cathode with the marked end as cathode.
No usable plotted forward-IV, reverse-leakage, capacitance, or other electrical curve was available in the supplied PDF; no curve points were invented.

Forward voltage, reverse current, capacitance, reverse recovery, breakdown voltage, and breakdown current are omitted because their electrical-characteristics pages are unavailable in the truncated source PDF.
No forward-voltage or reverse-leakage values were fitted from the visible maximum ratings; minimum, typical, and maximum semantics are not interchangeable.
omission_reason: The supplied public PDF is truncated after partial p. 1 and does not contain the electrical-characteristics pages or usable plotted curves needed for the requested diode extraction; only visible p. 1 maximum ratings and polarity information are reported.
